answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 13825 Country: Pakistan Title: Assalam-o-Alikum, Mufti sahib I want to know that the water of sea is pak or najs, because it is not flowing like other rivers, so I just want to know that is it correct to make wudhu or bath? jazakALLAH Question: Assalam-o-Alikum, Mufti sahib I want to know that the water of sea is pak or najs, because it is not flowing like other rivers, so I just want to know that is it correct to make wudhu or bath? jazakALLAH Answer ID: 13825 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 998/938=B/1430) The sea water is exceedingly maa-e-katheer (abundant water), such a water is considered as maa-e-jaari (flowing). In spite of not flowing it carries the ruling of the flowing rivers; therefore undoubtedly its water is tahir (clean and pure), one can perform wudhu and ghusl using the same. You should not fall in any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
